ios.desc:
Easily track your business miles and simplify your expense reports. This logbook offers a premium, automatic solution without monthly subscriptions.

Key Benefits:

• Pay Once, Own Forever: No hidden fees or recurring subscriptions. Lifetime access with one purchase.

• Seamless Automation: Full support for CarPlay and Siri. The app logs your trips automatically as you drive.

• Transparent Reporting: Generate PDF reports where manual modifications are marked with an asterisk (*) for honest record-keeping.

• Privacy Guard: Your data is stored in your own iCloud account. We never see or track your trips.

• Smart Classification: The app suggests whether a trip is Business or Private based on your work schedule.

• Vehicle Log: Record completed service, repairs, inspections, and costs for each vehicle.

• Easier Trip Management: View trips grouped by day, update the purpose of multiple incomplete trips at once, and see clearer information while a GPS trip is active.

show_hn.title: Show HN: An iOS mileage tracker I built because I hate forced logins

quotes.text:
I built this because I couldn’t find a mileage app that worked the way I wanted.

Most apps either force you to create an account, upload everything to their servers, or try to automate everything in a way that breaks real-world workflows.

I wanted manual start so I’m always in control, automatic stop so I don’t forget, no accounts, no backend, no tracking, and something that works even when I’m busy and not thinking about the app.

The app stores data locally and syncs via iCloud only. No servers, no analytics SDKs.

Happy to answer questions about the design choices or iOS implementation.
